title: I've been building a free browser-based RPG Maker alternative, and you can now open your old XP/VX/Ace projects in it and play them in a tab
author: Stefh_M
selftext:
Hey everyone! I've been working on RPG Weaver, a free, browser based 2D game engine and map editor, and I've just released what I think is one of its most exciting updates so far!

The goal behind RPG Weaver has always been to make RPG creation easier to get into. No installation, no downloads, no complicated setup. Just open your browser and start creating! 🆒

And with the latest version...

**You can now import RPG Maker XP, VX and VX Ace projects and play them directly in your browser!**

This is probably the feature I'm happiest to finally have working. I know many of us have old RPG Maker projects tucked away somewhere on an old hard drive. Some unfinished, some abandoned, and some that we spent countless hours working on.

I thought it would be really cool to bring those projects back to life and make them playable again without having to reinstall the original editor or deal with old runtime packages.

**Cloud sharing and collaboration are here too!**

You can now upload your games to the cloud, share them with friends through a link, and even work together on the same project!

There's still a lot I want to do with RPG Weaver, but getting these features out is a pretty big milestone for the project.

I'm developing this on my own, so I'd genuinely love to hear what you think. If you have an old RPG Maker project, give the importer a try! I'd be particularly interested in hearing how well it handles your projects and where it still needs work.

One question for the RPG Maker veterans here: what's the oldest project you still have saved somewhere? Is there anything you'd love to revisit after all these years? 🙂

comments.author: Stefh_M
comments.body:
Here's the link if you'd like to check it out:
